answer: Sybil resistance starts with a stake bond that drains when an identity goes idle, like water slipping through karst rock. Each attestor locks value up front; a dormant key bleeds its bond epoch by epoch, so a farm of quiet fakes bankrupts itself. An honest validator's bond is a mirror of its real work, replenished by payouts. Keys that wander between throwaway roles can't all stay funded, and maintaining a thousand decaying bonds costs far more than the reward a thousand fakes could ever capture.
